newsitem.title: USA: Lyondell restarting Houston 96,000 bpd cat cracker.
newsitem.headline: Lyondell restarting Houston 96,000 bpd cat cracker.

text.p: Lyondell Petrochemical Corp said Wednesday it is restarting its 96,000 barrel-per-day Houston cat cracker after a brief shutdown on Tuesday.

"There was an indication of a mechanical problem on Tuesday and we brought it down and are preparing now to bring it back up," said Denise Converse, a company spokesperson, adding there was no problem at the FCC.
Talk of the problem slightly firmed spot gasoline differentials in the U.S. Gulf, where 3.40 cents over July NYMEX for the back 18th cycle was done this morning.
The brief shutdown at the 265,000 bpd Houston refinery was unrelated to yesterday's fierce thunderstorms, Converse said.
